item.text: The direct `db.$client.end()` route is affected by a known issue in this project’s pinned Drizzle version. I’m switching to an explicitly owned `pg` pool, then closing that pool in `closeDb()`; it stays a one-file, small change and avoids the broken internal-client type.

item.text:
Added `closeDb()` in [src/db.ts](/tmp/lm-codex-demo/src/db.ts:14). It closes an explicitly owned `pg` connection pool.

I used an explicit pool because this project’s Drizzle version has a known issue with closing its implicit client. No type checks were run.
